name: workspace
description: Monorepo workspace for Altitutor apps and packages

scripts.check: turbo run lint && turbo run typecheck && turbo run test
scripts.db:types: supabase gen types typescript --local --schema public > packages/shared/src/supabase/generated.ts && pnpm turbo run build --filter=@altitutor/shared
scripts.db:committypes: supabase db reset && supabase db lint --local --level=error --fail-on error && pnpm db:types && git add packages/shared/src/supabase/generated.ts && (git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m 'chore: regenerate types')
